description: Run every check over a figure and give one verdict: clean, questionable, or wrong.
phrases: is this figure ready to send
one report over a whole figure
what is wrong with this before I submit it
returns: one section per check on stdout; the verdict and totals on stderr

examples.output:
warning      accessibility          -: this figure has no title; a reader who cannot see it has nothing to go on
warning      accessibility          -: this figure has no description; the geometry cannot supply one and nothing else will
unchecked    contrast               art.ink.stroke-001: the canvas background is 'none', so there is nothing to measure contrast against
style        unchecked -- no guide was given, so whether this figure is on style is unknown
regression   unchecked -- no reference image was given, so whether this figure has changed is unknown

notes: GENERATED from `lineart_trace.scene.cli.verb_report` by `python3 -m lineart_trace.records`. Edit that docstring, not this file: a record written by hand is a second copy of a description that already exists beside the code, and the two drift silently.
